mapper.select: SELECT room_id AS roomId, shelve_id AS shelveId, created_at AS createdAt FROM cage_shelf_bookmark WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_shelf_bookmark (user_id, room_id, shelve_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roomId}, #{shelveId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cage_shelf_bookmark WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND room_id = #{roomId} AND shelve_id = #{shelveId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cage_shelf_bookmark WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND room_id = #{roomId} AND shelve_id = #{shelveId}
